thought.text: Let me write the check to a file to avoid quoting issues:

reasoning_content: The bcrypt require failed. Let me look at the full error. Maybe it's a problem with the heredoc. I'll write to a file instead.

action.command:
cd /workspace && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && cat > /tmp/check_admin.rb <<'RUBY'
require "bcrypt"
u = User.find_by(email: "admin@consul.dev")
puts "bcrypt match: " + BCrypt::Password.new(u.encrypted_password).is_password?("Aa12345678").to_s
puts "confirmed: " + !u.confirmed_at.nil?.to_s
puts "administrator: " + (u.administrator ? "yes" : "no")
puts "role users: " + %w[mod@consul.dev manager@consul.dev valuator@consul.dev verified@consul.dev unverified@consul.dev].map { |e| e.split("@").first + "=" + User.where(email: e).count.to_s }.join(", ")
RUBY
timeout 200 bin/rails runner /tmp/check_admin.rb 2>&1 | tail -6
